overal.goal: readBody JSON-parses any body regardless of Content-Type and /api/* has no Origin check (only /mcp does), so a web page can POST a 'simple' text/plain request to http://127.0.0.1:4319/api/v1/... with no preflight; the peer is loopback and there is no X-Forwarded-For, so it runs as LOCAL_PRINCIPAL (admin). Require Content-Type: application/json for JSON ops and reject /api/* requests carrying an Origin that is not the server's own, as /mcp already does. Document that the Host guard is a DNS-rebinding defence, not a CSRF defence.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

/api/* and /mcp share an Origin guard (403 origin_not_allowed); a JSON body needs Content-Type: application/json (415 unsupported_media_type, owner default; bodyless POSTs and multipart unaffected); docs say the Host guard is a DNS-rebinding defence only; security.test.ts pins the cross-site case, the UI at the root, behind /boof/ and in the desktop app.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
